title:
Annual General Meeting 📅 
Blue Pits Housing Action 30.01.2025 

An "annual general meeting" (AGM) for a charity is a yearly gathering where the charity's members, usually meaning its supporters or donors, meet with the trustees to review the past year's activities, financial reports, and elect new trustees if necessary; essentially, it's a chance for the charity to update its members on its performance and solicit feedback.
